definitions.explanation: a cultivated area for growing crops or raising livestock, often implying a larger or more organized operation than a simple field

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧{農園|のうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{農園|のうえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather grows vegetables on a small farm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧{農園|のうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りて→借りる：00532_kariru⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{農作業|のうさぎょう}→農作業：14511_nousagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We rent a community garden plot and enjoy farming as a family on weekends.

notes:
Covers a range from large commercial plantations (coffee, tea, fruit) to small community garden plots. In modern urban Japan, ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧{農園|のうえん} (community garden/allotment) is a popular concept where city dwellers can rent small plots.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧{農園|のうえん}: community garden, allotment
- ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧{農園|のうえん}: tourist farm (pick-your-own)
- ⟦{果樹|かじゅ}→果樹：27144_kaju⟧{農園|のうえん}: fruit farm/orchard
- {農園|のうえん}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: farm management
- {貸|か}し{農園|のうえん}: rental garden plot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{農場|のうじょう}→農場：20586_noujou⟧: farm — more general, often larger scale or livestock-oriented
- ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧: field, vegetable garden — a specific cultivated plot, smaller scale
- ⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧: ranch, pasture — specifically for livestock
- ⟦{果樹園|かじゅえん}→果樹園：06472_kajuen⟧: orchard — specifically for fruit trees

ETYMOLOGY:
{農|のう} (agriculture) + {園|えん} (garden, park). The {園|えん} component gives it a slightly more cultivated or managed nuance than ⟦{農場|のうじょう}→農場：20586_noujou⟧.
